data.narrative:
Maritime Operations Group is a seed-stage company in the Defense & Security sector founded by Parker Stratton and Patrick Nanson. The valuation analysis draws from a comparables universe of 10 private peers and 2 public companies. Primary peers include UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI, alongside public benchmarks DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

The peer-median method forms the primary valuation anchor, drawing from three same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables. UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M) yield a median valuation of $400M with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. This method is applicable given the alignment of stage and sector characteristics across the peer set.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, with a median implied value of $400M. The single-method foundation warrants caution; valuation reliability hinges on the representativeness of the three-peer cohort and the relevance of Series A comparables to a seed-stage asset. Key uncertainties include relative technological differentiation versus peers, capital efficiency metrics, and customer traction or contracted revenue—none of which are reflected in the current data. Additional revenue-based or DCF-derived methods would strengthen conviction in this range.
